item_short_desc: Rothco’s 8-24 x 50MM Zoom Binoculars are perfect for sporting events, sightseeing, and any outdoor adventure. These high-performance binoculars offer adjustable magnification from 8 to 24 times, allowing you to zoom in on distant objects with precision. The 50MM objective lens ensures bright and clear images, while the ruby red coated optics enhance light transmission and reduce glare. Designed with comfort in mind, the binoculars feature soft, fold down eyecups that accommodate glasses wearers.
description: Rothco’s 8-24 x 50MM Zoom Binoculars are perfect for sporting events, sightseeing, and any outdoor adventure. These high-performance binoculars offer adjustable magnification from 8 to 24 times, allowing you to zoom in on distant objects with precision. The 50MM objective lens ensures bright and clear images, while the ruby red coated optics enhance light transmission and reduce glare. Designed with comfort in mind, the binoculars feature soft, fold down eyecups that accommodate glasses wearers. The rubber armoring provides a secure grip and added durability, making these binoculars ideal for rugged use. The easy-to-use adjust wheel enables rapid focusing, so you never miss a moment of the action. For convenient transportation and storage, the binoculars come with a carrying case and neck strap. Whether you're watching a game, exploring nature, or simply enjoying the great outdoors, Rothco’s 8-24 x 50MM Zoom Binoculars deliver exceptional performance and comfort.
